description: Election Commission -  Declare that Wijayakumar Joel Niroshan as a member of the Vavuniya Urban  Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Vavuniya Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a resigned member, including the nomination by a political party and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This content fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
